name: PacketLens
tagline: High-Performance Linux Raw Socket Network Analyzer
description: A lightweight command-line network packet analyzer and protocol decoder written in Python leveraging Linux raw sockets (`AF_PACKET`). Captures and dissects Ethernet II frames, IPv4/IPv6 headers, TCP three-way handshakes, UDP datagrams, and ICMP control messages in real-time.
architectureHighlights: Utilizes low-level `socket(AF_PACKET, SOCK_RAW, htons(ETH_P_ALL))` to bypass transport stack filters on Linux interfaces.
Binary parsing using Python standard `struct` unpacking for zero-dependency packet decoding.
Reconstructs TCP stream sequences and detects window exhaustion, syn floods, and connection resets.
Modular protocol handler dispatch pipeline allowing pluggable protocol dissectors.
keyChallenges: Handling high packet volume on saturated interfaces without dropping frames via ring buffer abstractions.
Big-endian to little-endian bitwise field unpacking across variable-length IP options headers.

specs.protocolOrFormat: Ethernet, IPv4, IPv6, TCP, UDP, ICMP
specs.testingStrategy: Virtual network namespaces (`ip netns`) and synthetic Scapy packet injection

name: MicroKV
tagline: Persistent In-Memory Key-Value Store with Write-Ahead Logging
description: An embeddable, asynchronous key-value storage engine engineered in Python. Combines memory-mapped storage indexing with an append-only write-ahead log (WAL) for durability, atomic crash recovery, and efficient read snapshots.
architectureHighlights: Append-only write-ahead log with CRC32 checksum verification for tamper and torn-write detection.
In-memory hash index with segment-based compaction and periodic background snapshots.
Asynchronous client/server protocol over TCP with custom binary framing and serialization.
Supports atomic multi-key batch transactions with isolation guarantees.
keyChallenges: Deterministic crash recovery log replay when recovering from mid-write process crashes.
Zero-downtime log compaction without locking write availability.

specs.protocolOrFormat: Custom binary framing (magic byte, len, opcode, payload, CRC32)
specs.testingStrategy: Automated fault injection scripts killing process during random write intervals

name: SysStat Daemon
description: A lightweight systems telemetry daemon that extracts real-time CPU scheduling metrics, memory slab allocation, disk I/O pressure, and context switch telemetry directly from Linux `/proc` and `/sys` virtual filesystems.
architectureHighlights: High-efficiency `/proc/stat`, `/proc/meminfo`, and `/proc/diskstats` polling using reusable file descriptors.
Zero-allocation streaming parser minimizing Python garbage collection pauses.
Calculates microsecond CPU core utilization deltas, interrupt frequencies, and page cache pressure.
Exports compact JSON and Prometheus-compatible scrape endpoints.
keyChallenges: Minimizing daemon CPU overhead to less than 0.5% during 100ms sampling intervals.
Parsing dynamic Linux kernel procfs differences across kernel generations.

specs.protocolOrFormat: Prometheus Text Metrics & JSON HTTP API
specs.testingStrategy: Stress-ng synthetic kernel load generation during telemetry runs

name: AlgoForge
description: A comprehensive laboratory and benchmark harness for fundamental computer science algorithms and data structures implemented from scratch. Features trie structures, disjoint-set unions, B-Trees, graph traversals, and algorithmic problem solutions.
architectureHighlights: Handcrafted implementations of Min-Heaps, Red-Black Trees, Graph shortest paths (Dijkstra/A*), and String matching (KMP, Rabin-Karp).
Automated asymptotic complexity verification suite comparing execution curves against theoretical Big-O.
Comprehensive test suites with randomized property-based test inputs.
keyChallenges: Rigorous edge-case validation for self-balancing tree rotations and cycle detection in cyclic graphs.

specs.testingStrategy: Property-based tests with Hypothesis and Pytest
